headline: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 16, 2026, titled "Release - HCLTech and Guardian Sign New Expanded Partnership for AI-powered Modernization Across Technology and Operations" along with a disclosure in terms of Regulation 30(4) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations 2015 regarding acquisition of stake in Guardian India Operations Private Limited i

llm_response.reasoning: The acquisition strengthens HCLTech's insurance domain expertise and AI capabilities, with a clear revenue contribution from Guardian India (FY26 revenue Rs. 578.8 crores). The low acquisition cost relative to revenue suggests value creation.
llm_response.summary: HCLTech announces a seven-year expanded partnership with Guardian and will acquire 100% of Guardian India Operations Private Limited for $10.5 million cash, integrating ~2,000 employees.
